summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX Appendix 3H notification of cessation of securities. The filing reports that 505,598 unquoted RADAN options with various expiry dates and exercise prices ceased on 31 May 2026 due to expiry without exercise or conversion, and no consideration was paid for the cessation. No other special-situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, going-private transaction, or strategic review—is described. The filing is a routine periodic notification of options expiration, not a special situation. No action is required or anticipated.
